implementation of the energy conservation

SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:

RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:

institutes are imparting training and issuing
diplomas and degrees for technical courses
such as marine engineering, etc. which are
not recognized by appropriate authorities;
(b) if so, how many such cases have
come to light during the last two years;

practices at the time when these institutes
advertise their courses in newspapers, etc.

public interest awareness  campaign in

malnutrition

 SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
 Will the Minister of WOMEN AND

five years and the outcome thereof;

Sharing of expenditure under SSA

contemplating to promote the use of CFL

capital; and

the same,  so that more power is saved?
